locator_detail: Appendix A, Olson Table A.5, Row O15a (printed pp. 110–111), Sample 218m (clear 9.525 mm PMMA rod)
reviewed_fact: Candidate test O15a in Olson Table A.5 burned clear 9.525 mm diameter (4.7625 mm radius) PMMA rod sample 218m under concurrent flow that changed during the test (15.6% initial O2, 15.2% final O2, calibrated flow 3.0 cm/s), ending in quenching with run-level pressure unreported.

locator_detail: Appendix A, Olson Table A.5, Row O15b (printed pp. 110–111), Sample 218m (clear 9.525 mm PMMA rod)
reviewed_fact: Candidate test O15b in Olson Table A.5 re-burned the same physical sample 218m (clear 9.525 mm PMMA rod) with changing flow during the test (15.2% initial O2, 14.9% final O2, calibrated flow 1.5 cm/s), ending in quenching with run-level pressure unreported.

locator_detail: Section 6.1, Figure 6.4 Staged-Flow PMMA Sequence (printed pp. 69–71)
reviewed_fact: In BASS-II Figure 6.4, airflow was reduced in steps and oxygen went from 14.8% initially to 13.6% finally; intermediate oxygen values, elapsed times, and unverified stage velocities remain null until reconciled with a specific run ID.
At the end of the staged airflow reduction in BASS-II Figure 6.4, oxygen concentration reached 13.6%.

locator_detail: NTRS 20150008961, Section 2 & Table 1: 24-Test ISS Concurrent-Flow PMMA Cohort and Companion Drop-Tower Tests
reviewed_fact: NTRS 20150008961 defines the 24-test ISS concurrent-flow PMMA rod cohort distinguishing low-flow radiative quenching from high-flow blowoff, alongside separate short drop-tower tests.

locator_detail: PSI-98 (DOI 10.60555/0t15-1z43) Investigation Summary & Cygnus Enclosure Telemetry
reviewed_fact: Saffire-I burned a large 0.4 m x 0.94 m SIBAL cotton-fiberglass fabric sheet aboard uncrewed Cygnus at 20 cm/s airflow in ~21% O2, ~101.3 kPa.

locator_detail: PSI-101 (DOI 10.60555/2np7-jv14) Final Report, Section 3 Smoke Particle Size Distributions
reviewed_fact: SAME-R measured moment-average smoke particle diameters and aging from overheated spacecraft materials (PMMA, cotton, Kapton, silicone, Teflon) in ISS microgravity.

locator_detail: PSI-69 (DOI 10.60555/mbq8-0451) FLEX Droplet Run Summary Table
reviewed_fact: FLEX quantified inert-gas dilution suppression and cool-flame behavior for isolated heptane and methanol fuel droplets in microgravity (15%–25% O2, 70–300 kPa).

locator_detail: NTRS 20250010653, Rotating New Shepard Sounding Rocket Flight Experiment
reviewed_fact: LUCI burned a 4 mm diameter acrylic (PMMA) rod and cotton-fiberglass fabric simultaneously in normal-pressure air (21.0% O2, 101.3 kPa) aboard a rotating Blue Origin New Shepard sounding rocket simulating lunar gravity (~1/6 g); oxygen readings apply at shared-chamber level.

locator_detail: NTRS 20240003211, Table 1 Recommended Crewed Lunar Exploration Atmosphere (8.2 psia, 34% O2)
reviewed_fact: NASA recommends a cabin exploration atmosphere assumption of 8.2 psia (56.5 kPa) total pressure and 34% oxygen for lunar surface rovers and habitats.

locator_detail: NTRS 20240003211, Table 1 Recommended Crewed Lunar Exploration Oxygen Concentration (34% O2)
reviewed_fact: The recommended exploration atmosphere specifies 34% oxygen by volume at 8.2 psia (56.5 kPa) total cabin pressure.

locator_detail: Section 4, Partial-Gravity Flammability Minimum & Buoyant Convection Crossover
reviewed_fact: Flammability limits in partial gravity (such as lunar 1/6 g) can extend beyond both microgravity and 1 g boundaries because moderate buoyant convection supplies oxidizer faster than 0 g diffusion without imposing 1 g blowoff strain.
